messages:
nora: deploy-bot flagged model-router canary -> HOLD after elevated 5xx rates during the slot. This blocks 2025.05.10-canary-roll. @ben can you take a look?

deploy-bot: [automated] HOLD applied per canary SLOs. Reason: 5xx rate exceeded threshold (1.8%). Slot: 2025-05-10T04:00Z. Suggested actions: pin component, run quick rollback, propose next slot.

ben: looking at traces now. Error bursts correlate with a new kernel optimization landed in the runtime candidate. KV cache miss storm under cold-starts triggered higher CPU on model-router and dropped some in-flight requests. Only observed in canary.

ops-oncall: confirmed traces. No impact to dedicated pools. CDN and edge are fine. Root cause points to runtime 2.1.7 patch that changed prefetch ordering.

tess: proposal: 1) pin model-router to runtime 2.1.6 (sha:ff12de), 2) reschedule canary to next low-traffic window 05/11 04:00 UTC, 3) add a short cooldown so prefetch warms before traffic shift. Also add quick smoke that verifies <0.2% 5xx and p95 <400ms for 10m.

nora: agree. Please pin and update the release note so we don't accidentally roll forward. We should also add a revert entry in the changelog.

ben: running pin now:
```
# pin model-router runtime to known-good
/releasebot pin 2025.05.10-canary-roll --component model-router --runtime 2.1.6 --sha ff12de
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/model-router model-router=image@sha:ff12de
```
I'll add: "Pinned model-router to runtime 2.1.6 due to increased 5xx during canary with runtime 2.1.7 prefetch change."

releasebot: action recorded: pin applied by ben at 1820000015. Canary hold remains. Next candidate slots: 1820086400 (2025-05-11 04:00 UTC), 1820172800 (2025-05-12 04:00 UTC).

avio-sales: FYI for customer schedule; flagging support to hold any scheduled demos during the 05/11 window.

ops-oncall: I'll add the cooldown step to the canary pipeline and schedule the smoke: `scripts/canary_smoke.sh --region global --checks 5xx,p95 --thresholds 0.2,400 --duration 600`. Alerts to #eng-oncall on failure.

tess: also add a canary gate that waits for KV cache hit-rate > 80% for 5m before allowing traffic shift.

nora: good. I'll write the changelog entry and internal release note. If smoke fails on 05/11 we'll extend the hold and consider reverting the runtime change in the upstream branch.

ben: pin complete and monitoring green so far. I'll post results after the 05/11 run.

nora: locking the thread. If anything else pops during the preflight we'll re-open and coordinate rollback. :lock:
